commands.name: split-right
commands.description: Split the focused pane: its shown tab moves to a new pane on the right.

commands.name: split-down
commands.description: Split the focused pane: its shown tab moves to a new pane below.

commands.name: focus-left
commands.description: Focus the pane to the left of the focused one.

commands.name: focus-right
commands.description: Focus the pane to the right of the focused one.

commands.name: focus-up
commands.description: Focus the pane above the focused one.

commands.name: focus-down
commands.description: Focus the pane below the focused one.

commands.name: maximize
commands.description: Show the focused pane alone, or bring the others back.

commands.name: close-pane
commands.description: Close the focused pane; its tabs join the next one.

commands.name: unsplit
commands.description: Put every tab back in one pane.

commands.name: go-to
commands.description: Open the quick switcher: find a tile by name, agent or folder; the ones that need you first, then the most recent. 1 to 9 jump.

commands.name: needs-you
commands.description: Show the tile that most recently started waiting on you (the app's ⌥⌘A / Ctrl+Alt+A does it from anywhere).

commands.name: last-tab
commands.description: Show the tile shown before this one.

commands.name: next-tab
commands.description: Show the focused pane's next tab.

commands.name: prev-tab
commands.description: Show the focused pane's previous tab.

commands.name: move-tab-next-pane
commands.description: Move the focused pane's shown tab to the next pane (with one pane, split it off to the right).

commands.name: move-tab-prev-pane
commands.description: Move the focused pane's shown tab to the previous pane (with one pane, split it off to the left).

commands.name: swap-pane
commands.description: Trade what the focused pane shows with the next pane's.

commands.name: equalize
commands.description: Make every pane's share of its split equal.

commands.name: broadcast
commands.description: Send what you type in one terminal to every terminal the panes show, or stop. Escape stops it too.

commands.name: open-layout
commands.description: Show a frame's or a page's tiles as a layout of their own (its panes are kept), or every tile.

commands.name: group-by
commands.description: Group the layouts strip by frame or by page.

commands.name: panes
commands.description: Say the layout shown, its panes and tabs, the groups, each tile's attention (needs-you, failed, done, new-output, working, quiet) and the terminals typing goes to.
